docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Tamil couplets on virtue, wealth and love, a classic of ethics and statecraft, in V. V. S. Aiyar's English.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Thiruvalluvar (date uncertain, early centuries AD), Tirukkural (Tamil), translated by V. V. S. Aiyar (1881–1925), 1916. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Wikisource. Modified: converted to this format.
